caption: The drawing features three outlined jugs at the top, each decorated with different patterns in black ink. The left jug has a floral design, the middle jug displays flags and the letters "N Y" with the U.S. and New York flags crossed, while the right jug shows a fish and a flower motif. The lower portion of the drawing consists of a brownish, textured background resembling soil or sand, with wavy lines at the top suggesting the surface. Objects depicted in this section include a wrapped candy on the left, clusters of round shapes (possibly resembling grapes or fruit), and the phrase "Made by Bill Howard" written in cursive script. Two crossed flags with a teepee between them and the text "N Y ork" appear in the center. On the right, there is a detailed fish and a stylized flower-like symbol drawn in dark ink. The colors used are primarily browns for the background and black or dark brown for the outlines and details.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
